phase: US financial V5 — private current-book TEST invoice issuance

invariants.book: Same immutable baseline, policy, ordered events, receipts and cursor. SQL replay validates prior history before and after replacements under the same locks. No second writable ledger and no historical rewrite.
invariants.issuance: Current accepted estimate, current open period, exact configured US/USD/accrual company. SQL reconstructs document, unique counter, snapshots, inner ERP commit, actual balanced AR/revenue/tax posting and audit. Financial revision, ledger revision and compact revision remain distinct.
invariants.settlement: Newly issued invoices are part of the sole current registry. Payments counted once; credits separately. Historical fingerprint excludes payments only. Received, credited and outstanding never conflated.
invariants.evidence: Context privately provisioned DB-owner only, immutable and without API secret. Preparation binds source revision/fingerprint, exact estimate, seller/tax context, reviewed classifications, location and tax instant. Outer financial and inner ERP request hashes are separate. Fixture retains test_fixture with explicit opt-in, never relabelled provider_observation.
invariants.protocol: Current SQL preflight before new catalogue/gateway work. Durable reservation before injected calculation; stored canonical parameters and original idempotency key/window retained. Proof and financial event/receipt/cursor plus committed operation are corroborated atomically. No claim that final CAS prevents all wasted calculations.
invariants.reservations: New command keys check financial receipts, private invoice reservations and frozen legacy tax preparations/operations. Every new event, including direct INSERT, respects the reservation. Historical replay does not apply newly introduced live reservations retroactively.
invariants.sources: Explicit PO011 before new calculation and append, not historical replay; frozen active order must be confirmed with exact source and chronology. PO008 retained for relevant new mutations. No legacy tax/store/sidecar thaw.
invariants.retries: Committed financial receipt checked before current merchant/source/catalogue. Lost responses resolve exact retained operations or receipts, with living grant. No new invoice number, provider key or expiry extension. Stale pending source/CAS refused rather than retargeted.
invariants.tax: Existing bounded exclusive taxable services and integer-quantity semantics only. No invented rates/exemptions/nexus/legal applicability. A calculation is not a tax transaction or filing/reversal. Taxed credits still need their own admissible private plan; no fabricated original transaction.
invariants.security: Living versioned TEST grant and trusted actor/clocks, RLS, ACL, invoker/empty search_path, immutable history and exact CAS. All older financial profiles reject unsupported invoice tails before replay/read/retry. Production Auth/D1/Stripe/PG authority is not atomically unified by local grants.
invariants.inherited: Promotion and first append separate; global administrative TRUNCATE restriction still affects protected CH/non-promoted tables. US/unknown isolation guard remains distinct from confirmed CH. Replay/snapshots bounded and PGlite serialized; no load/SLA/crash/multi-connection claim.

unit.transport: Real financial kernel and pure tax validators; explicitly synthetic RPC and injected gateway.

postgres.execution: Real local PostgreSQL WASM, 30 prior migrations plus new additive migration, mixed history and clean NodeFS close/reopen.

assertions.title: installs additively on a real prior credit without rewriting book or cursor
issues once, records two partial payments, then credits the exact remaining source on the same real ledger
returns exact original reservation/proof/append after later financial events without extending clocks
continues a credit, manual journal, closed period and new open period into issuance and settlement
rejects customer invoice append lacking the durable original calculation with zero mutation
preserves fixture provenance and rejects a fabricated provider observation in the calculation
closes all old financial profiles before replay of an invoice-only tail
rejects a stale book after calculation and leaves the stored pending operation intact
denies revoked/version changed/foreign tenant and nonfinancial authority on reads and append
keeps the context DB-owner-only and all fiscal/financial functions private invoker
requires a confirmed exact sales order before reserving, while an order-free source is admitted
fences every new mutation against invoice-reserved and legacy pending fiscal keys
reserves pending invoice and operation identities across requests
keeps an already valid historical fiscal-key collision readable and replayable after installation
requires atomic operation registration and forbids calculated operations inserted directly
rolls back direct invoice event, receipt and cursor unless its operation is atomically committed
rejects direct event use of a reserved fiscal key before any financial changes
rechecks live PO011 at append but never applies it to historical read, receipt or exact retry
rejects inner/outer hash confusion before fiscal catalogue or reservation
corroborates proof order, account, canonical text and chronology independently in SQL
rejects stale or widened context windows and preparations before their admitted observation
keeps completed history available when a fresh context can no longer be obtained
blocks issuance when a current period closes after calculation
retains the same canonical book and committed operation after clean NodeFS close/reopen
